definitions.explanation: Having the color of snow or milk.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っています→降る：00839_furu⟧。
{白|しろ}い⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ています→着る：00541_kiru⟧。

examples.english: I want my teeth to become white.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白|しろ}い⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like white flowers. At weddings, many people wear white dresses.

notes:
USAGE:
{白|しろ}い works both before a noun ({白|しろ}い⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧) and as a predicate (⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白|しろ}い). Beyond color it describes hair going grey and skin that is pale or fair, and it carries a secondary sense of "blank" or "innocent" — a suspect proved innocent is ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧.

FORMS:
- Noun form: ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (the color white; also "innocence")
- Adverbial: {白|しろ}く ({白|しろ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ = to become white)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {白|しろ}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at coldly or critically
- {白|しろ}い⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧: visible breath (in cold weather)
- ⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧: black and white

SIMILAR ADJECTIVES:
- {白|しろ}い: white
- ⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧: black (the direct opposite)
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: pale, thin — used for faint color rather than true white

CULTURE:
White symbolizes purity and cleanliness in Japan: a bride may wear a ⟦{白無垢|しろむく}→白無垢：27472_shiromuku⟧ (all-white wedding kimono). The same color also belongs to mourning and death, so white flowers are a poor choice for a celebratory gift.
